rating.reasoning_summary: This strand is pure noise masquerading as discourse. The boundary object is the word 'rape' itself, but there is no coherent narrative arc—only a collection of disconnected provocations, memes, and political dunks spanning 2019-2025. The earliest tweet (Visa's 'all ancestors fucked' joke) briefly touches on sexual violence as historical reality, but this thread immediately fragments into: edgy political compass memes (2023), viral rage-bait ('rape is worse than murder'), and cryptic one-liners from Curtis Yarvin. There is zero knowledge production, no refinement of concepts, and no community utility beyond shock value. This is thematic drift at its worst—tweets linked only by keyword overlap, not intellectual evolution.
